biggest_catch: Election Day is a 16-hour shift (6am-10pm); the base Clerk rate $225 comes to about $14/hr.
catches: Election-period work only (San Francisco Department of Elections).
Mandatory trainings required (two for Inspectors, one for Clerks) before serving; training compensation is not separately stated on this page.
Bilingual $20 bonus requires completing a bilingual review; materials-retrieval $20 bonus for Inspectors only.

eligibility: Be eligible to serve; apply via sf.gov page; complete mandatory training(s); able to serve full 6am-10pm Election Day.
notes: Route covers both listed roles (Clerk $225-$245, Inspector $255-$295); range $225-$295. Election Day hours 6am-10pm = 16 hrs = 960 min.

payout_quote: Inspectors earn between $255 and $295 for a full day of service on Election Day. Inspector base pay is $255. Inspectors earn a $20 bonus for retrieving election materials. Bonus of $20 is possible for bilingual speakers that complete a bilingual review. Clerks earn between $225 and $245 for a full day of service on Election Day. Clerk base pay is $225. Bonus of $20 is possible for bilingual speakers that complete a bilingual review. Serve on Election Day from 6am to 10pm.
payout_value_note: Clerk base $225 (+$20 bilingual review bonus = $245); Inspector base $255 (+$20 materials retrieval, +$20 bilingual review = $295).

steps: Apply online or at the Department of Elections office to be a poll worker.
Complete your mandatory training(s): two for Inspectors, one for Clerks.
Serve on Election Day from 6am to 10pm.
